_about: Per-unit overrides for tools/art/paper_doll.py (keys are documented there). joints: {joint name: location name | 'body'}.

catapult._why: the LRM launchers (ca_lmissile/ca_rmissile) are the Catapult's arms

flea._why: no arm joints: the outer side pods are the arms

raven._why: only a left arm joint (ra_luarm): the outer end of the right torso wing is the right arm

uller._why: narrow torso, far-out arm joints: the default split left a sliver of left torso

poweredarmor_mech._why: the left arm is skinned to pa_torso (only the gun has joint_lgun): the outer left torso is the arm
